lines.zh: 我从这根枝跳到那根，翅膀不出声。
lines.en: Branch to branch, my wings make no sound.

lines.zh: 夜里的林子，我的眼睛最亮。
lines.en: In the night wood, my eyes are the brightest thing.

lines.zh: 树皮粗糙，我的爪抓得很牢。
lines.en: The bark is rough and my talons hold it well.

lines.zh: 我掠过蕨叶，连风都没惊动。
lines.en: I skim the ferns without stirring the air.

lines.zh: 倒木上走两步，再飞起来。
lines.en: Two steps along the log, then up again.

lines.zh: 月光照在翅膀上，我几乎看不见。
lines.en: Moonlight on my wings makes me nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我沿着林线飞，找田鼠的味道。
lines.en: I fly the treeline, hunting the smell of voles.

lines.zh: 落枝很细，我收翅才站得住。
lines.en: The branch is thin; I fold my wings to stay on.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛擦过树叶，沙的一声。
lines.en: My feathers brush the leaves with a soft hiss.

lines.zh: 白天我躲进树洞，现在才出来。
lines.en: I hide in a hollow by day; only now do I come out.

lines.zh: 我盘旋一圈，把整片林子看清。
lines.en: One circle and I have seen the whole wood.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开时，比你想的宽。
lines.en: My wings are wider than you would guess.

lines.zh: 我落在老橡树上，俯看小路。
lines.en: I land in the old oak and look down at the path.

lines.zh: 我咕咕地叫，声音传得很远。
lines.en: I hoot, and the sound carries a long way.

lines.zh: 一只眼闭着，一只眼盯着树影。
lines.en: One eye shut, one fixed on the shadows.

lines.zh: 夜露打湿羽毛，我不去管。
lines.en: Night dew wets my feathers and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我把头转到背后，理了理翅。
lines.en: I turn my head back and tidy my wings.

lines.zh: 林子里有虫鸣，我听着。
lines.en: Insects sing in the wood and I listen.

lines.zh: 我鼓了鼓喉咙，又嚎了一声。
lines.en: I puff my throat and call again.

lines.zh: 这棵树的枝杈，正合我的爪。
lines.en: This fork of the tree fits my talons exactly.

lines.zh: 风一停，整片森林都静了。
lines.en: The wind stops and the whole forest goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我缩起一只脚，省点力气。
lines.en: I tuck one foot up to save strength.

lines.zh: 远处有老鼠跑过落叶，我听见了。
lines.en: A mouse crosses the leaves far off, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛蓬起来，显得更大。
lines.en: I fluff my feathers to look bigger.

lines.zh: 我盯着月亮，眼睛眨都不眨。
lines.en: I stare at the moon without blinking.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一串低低的咕声。
lines.en: A low run of hoots rolls from my throat.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我不急着飞。
lines.en: The night is long; I am in no hurry to fly.

lines.zh: 我理了理胸前的羽毛。
lines.en: I smooth the feathers on my chest.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀看起来能站，我打量着。
lines.en: Your shoulder looks steady enough to perch on.

lines.zh: 我歪头，一只眼对着你的眼。
lines.en: Head tilted, one eye lined up with yours.

lines.zh: 你捏着的那块，能分我一点吗？
lines.en: That morsel you hold, could I have some?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，脖子转了一百八十度。
lines.en: I fix on you and turn my neck right around.

lines.zh: 你脚步放轻了，我听得出来。
lines.en: You have softened your steps; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我从枝上俯看你，像看一只田鼠。
lines.en: From the branch I study you like a vole.

lines.zh: 你的火光让我眼睛有点晃。
lines.en: Your torchlight makes my eyes swim a little.

lines.zh: 我离你这么近，你居然没发现。
lines.en: I am this close and you never noticed.

lines.zh: 你抬手时，我羽毛轻轻一紧。
lines.en: When you raise a hand, my feathers tighten.

lines.zh: 我眨一只眼，再眨另一只。
lines.en: I blink one eye, then the other.

lines.zh: 你身上有面包的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: You smell of bread; I will remember that.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I dip my head and look you over head to foot.

lines.zh: 你要伸手，我可能就跳上去。
lines.en: Reach out, and I might just hop on.

lines.zh: 你不动，我不动，枝叶也不动。
lines.en: You hold still, I hold still, even the twigs.

lines.zh: 你的帽子像个小树洞。
lines.en: Your hat looks like a little hollow.

lines.zh: 我从这边看你的侧脸。
lines.en: I study your face from the side.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯晃得很慢。
lines.en: The lantern in your hand sways slowly.

lines.zh: 你的声音我听过。
lines.en: I've heard your voice before.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只爪，试了试风。
lines.en: I lift one talon and test the wind.

lines.zh: 你要走，我大概会跟。
lines.en: If you leave, I might follow.

lines.zh: 我咕地叫了一声，翅膀歪了。
lines.en: I hoot once, and my wing hangs crooked.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一地，风一吹就散。
lines.en: Feathers scatter on the ground and blow away.

lines.zh: 这一下伤得我站不稳树枝。
lines.en: That hit left me unsteady on the branch.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛还在盯你，别过来。
lines.en: My eyes are still on you; stay back.

lines.zh: 疼得我把头缩进羽毛里。
lines.en: It hurts so much I pull my head into my feathers.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了一角，飞不高了。
lines.en: One wing is bent and I cannot fly high.

lines.zh: 我嘶哑地叫，声音像破布。
lines.en: My call comes out rasping, like torn cloth.

lines.zh: 血落在树皮上，黑黑的一点。
lines.en: Blood falls on the bark in a dark little spot.

lines.zh: 我只有六点命，撑不了几下。
lines.en: I have only six points; I cannot take much.

lines.zh: 别打翅膀，我还要靠它活。
lines.en: Not the wings; I need them to live.

lines.zh: 你手里有吃的，我飞近了一点。
lines.en: You have food, so I fly a little closer.

lines.zh: 不管是肉还是果子，我都想试。
lines.en: Meat or fruit, I want to try either.

lines.zh: 我有三分之一的可能信你。
lines.en: There is a one-in-three chance I trust you.

lines.zh: 这块食物在我眼前晃，很碍事。
lines.en: That food swings before me, very distracting.

lines.zh: 我落低一根枝，再看清楚些。
lines.en: I drop one branch lower to see it better.

lines.zh: 举那么高，我的爪抓不到。
lines.en: Held that high, my talons cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 吃了你的东西，我可能就不走了。
lines.en: Eat your food and I may not leave.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经松开树枝了。
lines.en: My talons have already loosened on the branch.

lines.zh: 这味道让我忘了该怕你。
lines.en: This smell makes me forget to fear you.

lines.zh: 你摊开手掌，我犹豫了很久。
lines.en: You open your palm and I hesitate a long while.

lines.zh: 再靠近半步，我就啄了。
lines.en: Half a step more and I peck.

lines.zh: 食物很香，可你的手太大。
lines.en: The food smells good, but your hand is huge.

lines.zh: 我鸣了一声，算是回答你。
lines.en: I give one call as my answer.

lines.zh: 你要真给，我就真吃。
lines.en: If you really offer, I will really eat.

lines.zh: 你把肉放低，我就下来了。
lines.en: Lower the meat, and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，还是不敢。
lines.en: I sniff it. Still too afraid.

lines.zh: 这味道让我喉咙发紧。
lines.en: The smell tightens my throat.

lines.zh: 你的头撞到我了，羽毛乱了一撮。
lines.en: Your head bumped me and ruffled a tuft.

lines.zh: 我从你肩上滑下来，赶紧张翅。
lines.en: I slide off your shoulder and snap my wings open.

lines.zh: 你走路不看树，我可在这儿。
lines.en: You walk without looking at the trees; I am here.

lines.zh: 被你撞得转了个圈，真丢脸。
lines.en: Bumped into a spin, which is embarrassing.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子才没掉下去。
lines.en: I grabbed your sleeve so I would not drop.

lines.zh: 这一下让我咕地叫出了声。
lines.en: That knock made me hoot out loud.

lines.zh: 我的爪在你衣领上勾了个洞。
lines.en: My talons left a hole in your collar.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我拍了拍翅膀。
lines.en: When you backed off, I clapped my wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀撞在树枝上，有点麻。
lines.en: My wing hit a branch and went numb.

lines.zh: 下次让让，我夜里眼神好，白天不行。
lines.en: Give way next time; I see at night, not by day.

lines.zh: 我在夜里叫了很久，她回了一声。
lines.en: I called a long time, and she answered once.

lines.zh: 两根枝挨得近，我们并排站着。
lines.en: Two branches close together, and we stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛理顺，再靠近她。
lines.en: I smooth my feathers before edging toward her.

lines.zh: 她低头的姿势，我认得。
lines.en: I know that way she dips her head.

lines.zh: 树洞里铺着软羽，够暖。
lines.en: The hollow is lined with soft down, warm enough.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着这片林子。
lines.en: We take turns watching over this wood.

lines.zh: 她一叫，我的羽毛就松了下来。
lines.en: When she calls, my feathers loosen all at once.

lines.zh: 我把抓到的田鼠推给她。
lines.en: I push the vole I caught over to her.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我们各自回树洞。
lines.en: Dawn is near; we each return to our hollow.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，会有小猫头鹰。
lines.en: By this time next year there will be owlets.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓起一只甲虫。
lines.en: I lift a beetle in my talons.

lines.zh: 树枝太粗，我的爪合不上。
lines.en: The branch is too thick for my talons to close.

lines.zh: 这块肉我叼不稳，掉了。
lines.en: I cannot hold this meat steady and drop it.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛一格一格理好。
lines.en: I put my feathers in order, one row at a time.

lines.zh: 有根线缠住我的爪，真烦。
lines.en: A thread is wound round my talon, irritating.

lines.zh: 我抓起落叶，它又飘走了。
lines.en: I grab a leaf and it drifts away again.

lines.zh: 田鼠太沉，我贴着地面飞。
lines.en: The vole is heavy, so I fly low over the ground.

lines.zh: 我叼起小石子，不知为什么。
lines.en: I pick up a pebble for no reason at all.

lines.zh: 把这个放到树洞里，正合适。
lines.en: This fits nicely in the hollow.

lines.zh: 爪子空着，我就想抓点什么。
lines.en: With empty talons I want to grab something.

lines.zh: 落叶下有东西在动，我盯住了。
lines.en: Something moves under the leaves and I lock on.

lines.zh: 那只田鼠跑不出我的视线。
lines.en: That vole cannot get out of my sight.

lines.zh: 我听见草茎被压断的声音。
lines.en: I hear a stem snap underfoot.

lines.zh: 一只虫在树皮上爬，我看见了。
lines.en: A bug crawls on the bark and I see it.

lines.zh: 我锁定那道影子，翅膀收紧。
lines.en: I fix on that shadow and tuck my wings in.

lines.zh: 老鼠的味道从那边飘来。
lines.en: The smell of mouse drifts over from there.

lines.zh: 我转头，把声音的来源对准。
lines.en: I turn my head to face the sound.

lines.zh: 目标很小，但够我吃一顿。
lines.en: The target is small, but enough for a meal.

lines.zh: 它一露头，我就记住了位置。
lines.en: The moment it showed, I marked the spot.

lines.zh: 夜里没什么能躲过我的眼睛。
lines.en: Nothing hides from my eyes at night.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，羽毛贴着背。
lines.en: I lower myself with my feathers flat.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，等最后一刻。
lines.en: Wings half open, waiting for the last moment.

lines.zh: 它动一下，我的头就跟着动。
lines.en: It twitches, and my head follows.

lines.zh: 我在算飞下去的角度。
lines.en: I am working out the angle of my dive.

lines.zh: 树枝挡了一点视线，我挪了挪。
lines.en: A branch blocks part of my view, so I shift.

lines.zh: 风从那边来，它闻不到我。
lines.en: The wind comes from there, so it cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 我的爪已经张开，收在腹下。
lines.en: My talons are open, tucked under my body.

lines.zh: 再等一等，它会更近。
lines.en: Wait a little longer and it comes nearer.

lines.zh: 呼吸放慢，别惊动落叶。
lines.en: I slow my breathing so the leaves stay still.

lines.zh: 就差这一下，我屏住气。
lines.en: Just this one strike; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去，爪子先到！
lines.en: I dive, and my talons arrive first!

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我砸在它背上。
lines.en: Wings folded, I strike its back.

lines.zh: 这一抓，用上了我全部的力。
lines.en: That grip used every bit of my strength.

lines.zh: 我的喙接着啄下去。
lines.en: My beak comes down right after.

lines.zh: 它挣扎时，我的羽毛被扯掉一根。
lines.en: As it fought, one of my feathers was torn out.

lines.zh: 尘土扬起，我已经抓住它了。
lines.en: Dust rises, and I already have it.

lines.zh: 我把它按在落叶上，不让它跑。
lines.en: I pin it to the leaves so it cannot run.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，但足够。
lines.en: The blow was light, but it was enough.

lines.zh: 我咕地叫了一声，宣告结束。
lines.en: I hoot once to announce that it is over.

lines.zh: 飞回枝上时，爪子还带着暖意。
lines.en: Flying back to the branch, my talons still warm.

lines.zh: 我破壳时，森林正下着小雨。
lines.en: When I broke the shell, a fine rain was falling.

lines.zh: 树洞很暗，只有我的眼睛亮。
lines.en: The hollow is dark; only my eyes shine.

lines.zh: 羽毛干了以后，我才敢动。
lines.en: I did not move until my feathers dried.

lines.zh: 第一声叫，哑得只有自己听见。
lines.en: My first call was so hoarse only I heard it.

lines.zh: 母亲把半只田鼠放在我面前。
lines.en: Mother set half a vole before me.

lines.zh: 夜风从洞口灌进来，很凉。
lines.en: The night wind pours through the opening, cold.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，撞到了树壁。
lines.en: I spread my wings and hit the hollow's wall.

lines.zh: 这片林子，以后有我的一份。
lines.en: This wood will have my share of it from now on.

lines.zh: 我学着把头转到背后，成了。
lines.en: I practice turning my head back, and manage it.

lines.zh: 月亮升起来，我第一次飞出洞。
lines.en: The moon rose and I flew out for the first time.

lines.zh: 火燎过羽毛，那股焦味我自己都怕。
lines.en: Flame singes my feathers and even I fear that smell.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，翅膀没来得及张开。
lines.en: I drop, and my wings never got open.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸饱了水，我沉得很快。
lines.en: My feathers soak up water and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 爆响里，我被震离了树枝。
lines.en: In the blast I am thrown clean off the branch.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的翅骨，我歪着飞。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing bone and I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 那股紫光让我分不清上下。
lines.en: That purple light leaves me unable to tell up from down.

lines.zh: 林子里没田鼠，我饿得直叫。
lines.en: No voles in the wood and hunger keeps me calling.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的影子印在树干上。
lines.en: In the lightning flash my shadow is printed on the trunk.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，连风都不肯托我。
lines.en: I fall, and even the wind refuses to hold me.
